name: Knowledge Search
description: Search your files, chats, projects and memory, and cite them.
abilities: Finds the passages in your files, past chats, projects and memory that answer a question
Says where each one came from: the file, the chat and its date, the project or your memory
Keeps to this chat's project or library when you ask
permissions: Searches only your own Workspace, and only the memory the chat uses
Indexed in Dyadic at no cost and never sent to another service for it
Shares your 500 MB search index with your vector stores

changes.notes: Replaces File Search: it also searches your chats, projects and memory. If you had File Search off, this is off too.
